rules.rule: Keep getEnvelopeWhereInput and getMultipleEnvelopeWhereInput as the only access gate for envelopes and add nothing after the marked line.
rules.why: A mistake leaks one customer's documents to another user or team.

rules.rule: Do not make breaking changes to ZEnvelopeEditorSettingsSchema or related editor types.
rules.why: The embedded editor lives in another repo and breaks for customers if the schema changes.

rules.rule: Do not loosen CSS_LENGTH_REGEX without re-checking toNativeCssVars.
rules.why: The radius value is interpolated raw into a <style> block, so a looser pattern is CSS injection into signing pages.

rules.rule: The certificate and audit-log render routes and all their children use _(msg``) and never <Trans>.
rules.why: not-found.tsx overrides the i18n instance on these pages, so <Trans> renders in the wrong language in generated PDFs.

rules.rule: Mirror changes between reject-document-with-token.ts and reject-document-on-behalf-of.ts.
rules.why: They are intentionally separate; drift leaves one path skipping checks or rejection jobs.

rules.rule: Each tRPC route is one file plus a .types.ts holding the OpenAPI meta and Z[Name]RequestSchema/ResponseSchema; OpenAPI meta uses only GET and POST; update routes nest data under `data`.
rules.why: The public API V2 and its OpenAPI document are generated from these files; other shapes break API clients.

rules.rule: Never mock in tests; use Playwright E2E against the real database, and keep vitest to pure functions.
rules.why: The team's AGENTS.md treats mocked tests as non-tests; they pass while real behaviour breaks.

rules.rule: /embed/auth pages must never be framed and the auth nonce must never be a rate limit key.
rules.why: A hostile page could drive the postMessage handshake, or the nonce would be stored in plaintext.

rules.rule: Keep SessionUser free of sensitive data.
rules.why: It is serialised to the browser, so anything added is exposed to every visitor of that session.

rules.rule: assertMemberCountWithinCap is called only on grow paths (invite, add), never on reduce paths.
rules.why: Gating removal would stop over-cap organisations from fixing their seat count.
